q: Does a harmonic filter save electricity in a factory with many drives?
title: Do harmonic filters save energy?
short: A little, mostly by cutting heating losses in cables and transformers. The bigger gains are fewer drive trips, longer capacitor life and a steadier power factor. Measure total harmonic distortion and kWh before and after; do not assume a saving figure.
audience: Factories with VFDs, induction furnaces, UPS systems or LED loads

p: Harmonic currents add to RMS current, which heats cables and transformers. Removing them lowers those losses, usually a small share of total consumption.

ol: Log THD and kWh at the main incomer for a typical week.
Install the filter and log again under the same production.
Count only the measured change, multiplied by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for Indian grid power.
